limits.network_policy: public primary sources, pinned shared corpus snapshot where applicable

dataset_separation.development: public or synthetic, labeled as such
dataset_separation.final: private, recent, independently annotated; not yet supplied

analysis.unit: task, retaining repetitions as a cluster
analysis.multiplicity: Holm correction for confirmatory pairwise comparisons
analysis.review: two blinded independent annotators; disagreements adjudicated before arm unblinding

win_requires: all required arms executed under recorded comparable conditions
lower adjusted confidence bound exceeds minimum useful gain
claim_policy.missing_access: report blocked/unmeasured; do not substitute a synthetic Kimi result

amendments: Any baseline, task, metric, threshold or exclusion change requires a new protocol file/version/hash and explanation before confirmatory evaluation.
